---
title: "International RSE Survey Books"
---

Each survey year is presented independently using the questions and answer
options contained in that year's dataset. No cross-year harmonisation is
applied.

## Survey years

- [2016 survey](2016/)
- [2017 survey](2017/)
- [2018 survey](2018/)
- [2022 survey](2022/)
- [2026 survey — curated analysis](2026/)

The 2016–2022 books are generated dynamically from the corresponding response
and question-metadata files. The 2026 book retains the curated Nordic insights
and question-by-question analysis.
